title: JavaScript Fetch Retry Logic with Exponential Backoff
title_es: Lógica de Reintento en JavaScript Fetch con Backoff
description: Retry failed fetch() calls with exponential backoff, full jitter, AbortSignal timeouts, a circuit breaker, and idempotency-safe POSTs.
description_es: Reintenta llamadas fetch() fallidas con backoff exponencial, jitter completo, timeouts con AbortSignal, un circuit breaker y POSTs idempotentes.
